events.title: CATadel v1.6 — A gentler first round
events.summary: A gentler first round Learn one step at a time: spin, watch the troops attack, then collect gold. Battle from your carriage Watch fire arrows and arcing magic from your carriage. Hits show scores immediately, with extra strikes for multipliers. Little cat signals Miniature cats signal troop attacks, roam and jump on the carriage, and scamper away from your cursor. A quieter welcome Lower starting volume, no loading meow, and a small mute icon always within reach. Play the free CATadel demo

events.title: Demo v1.5 — Coins in motion
events.summary: https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/46288778/2595d29453b6f0a5e911c0a6f7ff2e82f6ec319b.jpg Your coin drawer Copper, silver and gold collect in a drawer. Drag to stir; click to collect. Coins in motion Coin bursts have varied bounce timing, smoother reflections and clearer impact sounds. Smoother betting Bet directly on the slot. After the receipt prints, return to the slot. Cancelling sends the coins back. A clearer view Pixel materials, actual Bold fonts, panel placement and live language

events.title: Demo v1.4 — A clearer betting slip
events.summary: https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/46288778/e4599d6d334e58b28e86bb64a7163458c8d01df7.jpg A clearer betting slip Choose cells and units on one slip. Change or cancel a bet before spinning. Fixed upgrade prices Unit appearance and formation upgrades now have a fixed base price of 3 Crowns. Enhanced tiles appear at 3%, 2% or 1%, depending on the unit. Bigger wins, clearer results Win effects scale with the odds, with new coin effects and a larger hit display. A clean restart Fixed game-over

events.title: Demo v1.3 — Play at your pace
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46288778/27d49f8d238feb8c3501be7eb5f0eb1ef6c16c75.jpg A lighter CATadel Smaller installation files, a new Low-spec Mode, and optimizations for market loading, coins, catapults and enemy destruction. Play at your pace Click to speed up combat, settlement and catapult animations to ×2 and ×4. Moving arrows and a short tick mark each speed increase. Clearer reports and kitchen controls Larger scout details and clearer cursed tiles. Kitchen buttons no longer overlap; added an exit

events.title: Demo v1.2 — Meet Stephi
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46288778/090994f880e9e9fd5bc583c36abdf3f735db125a.jpg Meet Stephi Stephi, the black cat puppet, joins the tutorial and cheers you on throughout your run. Roulette improvements Updated the roulette backdrop, coin piles, sounds, and win or lose reactions. Bosses and telegrams Boss skill cards show effects and activations. A breached gate now leads through a telegram and execution. Relic unlocks and guidance Unlock cards appear over run results. Confirm all cards before returning

events.title: Demo v1.1 - Boss Bug: Fix in Progress
events.summary: A boss-related bug was found after the CATadel demo v1.1 update. I am working on a fix now. I am sorry for the trouble, and thank you for your patience and bug reports. I will post another update when the fix is live.

events.title: Demo hotfix — 3 weeks and cooking limits
events.summary: New demo runs cover 3 weeks. Combo and multiplier stacking currently inflate damage and scores; we shortened the demo while continuing balance work. Existing 5-week saves can continue to their original ending, and saved progress, ingredients and prepared dishes are preserved. New cooking is limited to bratwurst bread and butter-fried apples; shops sell only their ingredients and the two beers.
